leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a typed registry interface with generic constraints
Implement a registry class that enforces key-value type relationships
Apply TypeScript's keyof and mapped types to constrain registry operations
Configure type-safe methods for adding and retrieving registry entries
Manipulate the registry with compile-time validation of key constraints
Initialize a registry instance with properly typed initial data
Integrate the typed registry into a simple demonstration module
lessonTitle: Build typed registry with key constraints
